intent: Make each compliance procedure feel inevitable from the nature of the object it governs, while sharing a small cognitive kernel that continuously reduces user effort without collapsing epistemic distinctions.

commonPrimitives.question: Che cosa richiede una decisione umana adesso?
Quale prova resta dopo questa azione?
commonPrimitives.budget: one compact signal; detail on demand

commonPrimitives.question: Che cosa non posso concludere da questo stato?
Serve lavoro in un altro processo?
commonPrimitives.budget: typed draft only; no inherited decision

cognitiveInvariants: No surface requires reading history, hashes, AI traces or raw provenance to identify the next meaningful action.
Normal state is quiet; attention is explicit and non-additive unless the metric contract says otherwise.
One concept is explained once per final view; repeated context is collapsed into progressive detail.
AI is visible only where it changes the user's next review task; configuration and traces are subordinate.
Terminal negative states remain valid outcomes and never imply mandatory remediation by presentation alone.
Auditor mode prefers identity, authority, owner, version, review and evidence before edit affordances.

RN-01.object: bounded public regulatory or jurisprudential source observation
RN-01.intent: Keep all and only the declared public-source classes under observation, preserve originals and turn verified observations into reviewable semantic atoms and impact work.
RN-01.demoRule: Every monitoring record must belong to exactly one allowed public-source class; vendor release notes, customers, suppliers and internal operations are not RN sources.

EC-01.object: event case with preserved original narrative and awareness time
EC-01.intent: Move from original fact pattern to a human-confirmed case while keeping facts, assumptions, AI formulation and legal significance separate.
EC-01.demoRule: Synthetic cases must preserve original narrative, awareness time, human confirmation and downstream work as separate records.
EC-01.localMetric: one current question and one primary action

AO-01.intent: Make the inventory defensible to a severe auditor: identity, source authority, accountable owner, criticality basis, dependencies, lifecycle and attestation must be reconstructable.
AO-01.demoRule: Each synthetic object must have a plausible object type, explicit source authority, owner, lifecycle state and review basis; generic placeholder authority is insufficient.

MC-01.object: declared normative or framework concept node and its reviewed mappings
MC-01.intent: Represent selected laws, standards and frameworks as minimal complete neutral concepts, then keep scope, mapping, gap and crosswalk decisions distinct.
MC-01.demoRule: Every synthetic mapping must point to a declared concept/reference and preserve the difference between tracked, applicable, mapped, gap and effective.
MC-01.localMetric: all displayed concept atoms complete; drilldown opaque

AP-01.intent: Turn an accepted origin into accountable work where adoption, execution, completion evidence and verified closure remain distinct.
AP-01.demoRule: Every synthetic action must have a reconstructable origin, owner, expected outcome and closure evidence semantics.
AP-01.localMetric: origin, owner, next step and closure criterion visible together

RC-01.object: compliance risk scenario with human rating and treatment
RC-01.intent: Keep scenario, bindings, inherent rating, treatment, mitigation and residual review human-owned and reconstructable.
RC-01.demoRule: Synthetic ratings remain DEMO-persona judgments and never derive legal nature from text or score.
RC-01.localMetric: human judgment explicit wherever rating appears

AR-01.object: assurance request and versioned response set
AR-01.intent: Preserve the request and make every answer, evidence, limitation and approved response version reconstructable without implying independent assurance.
AR-01.demoRule: Synthetic approval means internal response approval only; evidence sufficiency and independent assurance remain separate.

convergence.method: discover normalized failure families from seeded typical, edge, stress and adversarial states; compress equivalent witnesses; stop discovery at finite M; require the next exact 1000 seed-separated states to add zero genuinely new normalized families
forbiddenCompression: merge inventory presence and real-world completeness

claimBoundary: This contract governs software experience and synthetic engineering evidence. It does not establish legal applicability, compliance, control effectiveness, certification, representative usability or independent assurance.
